# SYNTHETIC JOB DESCRIPTION 02 — Fast-Growing Startup Frontend Engineer
# Label: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE (NOT A REAL JOB POSTING)

Job Title: Junior Frontend Engineer (0-1 Years Experience / Fresher)
Company: QuikCart Technologies
Location: Bengaluru, India (On-site)
Salary: ₹8.0 - ₹12.0 LPA + ESOPs

About Us:
QuikCart is building next-generation quick commerce infrastructure for hyper-local retail in tier-1 Indian cities. We love fast shipping, clean code, and delightful user experiences.

Responsibilities:
• Build modular, accessible, and responsive user interfaces using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
• Integrate with backend GraphQL and REST APIs, managing client cache with TanStack Query.
• Collaborate with UI/UX designers to translate Figma prototypes into pixel-perfect components.
• Write automated component tests using Vitest and React Testing Library.
• Optimize web application performance, Core Web Vitals, and load times under 3G network conditions.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
• Demonstrated proficiency in modern JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, and React.
• Hands-on mastery of HTML5, CSS3, modern layout techniques (Flexbox, Grid), and Tailwind CSS.
• Working knowledge of state management (Zustand, Redux Toolkit, or React Context).
• Experience consuming RESTful APIs and handling asynchronous data streams.
• Active GitHub profile demonstrating at least 2 polished web applications with live deployment links.

Nice to Have:
• Familiarity with Next.js (App Router) and Server-Side Rendering (SSR).
• Experience with frontend bundling tools (Vite) and Docker containers.
• Understanding of web accessibility (WCAG AA) standards.
